name: The Great Zimbabwe

categories.label: Victory points collected
categories.hint: Your marker on the VP track at the end of the game.

categories.label: Victory requirement (VR)
categories.hint: Your VR marker; rises with gods, specialists and technologies (max 40).

categories.label: VP minus VR
categories.hint: Positive means you reached your VR; most overshoot wins.

tiebreakers.description: Among players who reached VR, most VP above own VR wins
Then the player earlier in turn order wins.

notes: family: race-to-threshold. Game ends immediately when at least one player has VP >= own VR; if exactly one has, they win. Only players with VP >= VR are eligible; the score here (VP - VR) is only meaningful if at least one player is >= 0. The 'overshoot' field is entered as a raw expression of the two inputs; enter VP and VR above. Source is a rules transcription (UltraBoardGames); official rulebook not retrieved, so confidence medium.
